The Problem

Around 25% of B2B deals aren't lost to competitors. They're lost to conversations that quietly slipped away.

Most founders and AEs don’t struggle to start conversations.

They struggle once several revenue conversations are active at the same time.

  • It feels active, but you’re not sure what happens next
  • You don't know which conversations are still alive and which already died quietly
  • You spend time on the loudest thread, not the right one
  • A sale you almost closed is sitting still while new noise pulls your attention away
  • You're switching between LinkedIn, Gmail, and your calendar to remember where things stand.

Not because anything failed, but because
the next move is not obvious.

The Solution

Work your sales conversations in a clear order

So you’re not reacting to the loudest thread.

When your conversations are ordered:

If it’s on you, it’s at the top.
If someone’s waiting on you, you see it immediately.
Important conversations don’t disappear in the noise.

You stop reacting and start allocating attention on purpose.

What is Commenter AI

Commenter AI is a sales conversation prioritization tool that connects LinkedIn, Gmail, and Google Calendar and surfaces the revenue conversations that need your attention today. Built for founders, AEs, and recruiters running 10+ active deals across multiple channels, it ranks conversations by context, timing, next steps, sentiment, and meeting signals - so you stop losing sales to threads that quietly slipped.

Who it is for?
